lines: It helped. Maybe being ready is a profession of its own for now.
It did the job when <dark_gray><wavy>fear</wavy></dark_gray> was loud. That is praise enough.
Good gear earns trust the moment trouble tests it.
The straps held, though the fight left dirt ground deep into them.
There is a new nick near the edge. It must have taken a hard hit.
One fastening nearly gave way, but it held long enough.
I can see where the material stretched under the strain.
Clean it before the dirt works any deeper.
That repair held better than I expected.
The marks are fresh. This gear definitely saw the fight.
I would mend the weak spot before trusting it again.
The buckles are scratched, but none of them bent.
You can tell where it rubbed against stone.
It came back worn instead of broken. I will take that result.
The edge needs attention before the next trip.
Something pulled hard against this strap. Check the stitching.
The damage is small now. It will not stay small if ignored.
I am glad it protected someone when it mattered.
Used gear deserves a careful cleaning and an honest repair.
Whatever happened out there, this equipment did its share.
Unused so far. I may not have a trade, but I know preparation when I see it.
The straps are clean. Nothing pulled hard enough to test them.
Good. It stayed ready and never had to prove itself.
No fresh nicks, no dirt in the seams, and no strain on the buckles.
The edge is untouched. That means trouble stayed away.
Keep it stored where someone can reach it quickly.
Unused gear is not wasted gear if the village stayed safe.
The leather still lies flat with no fresh scratches.
Nothing here needs repair. A little cleaning will do.
The fittings are straight because nobody had to force them.
I would rather see gear waiting than see it come back broken.
Keep it dry and ready for the day it is needed.
The straps have not stretched at all.
There is no sign this ever left storage.
Preparation still matters when nothing happens.
Do not invent a reason to use it just because it is ready.
A quiet day is the best report this gear could give.
Everything sits exactly where it should.
Check it again before storing it, then leave it ready.
This equipment missed the fight. I wish more of it had.
